category_edits.rationale: Across all four category models, jointly lower Adam learning rate to 5e-4 and dropout to 0.10. Smaller updates may improve convergence precision while reduced dropout preserves signal in short histories. Keep all other settings, features, architecture, scoring and loss unchanged. Existing metadata and predictor reconstruction remain compatible; inference disables dropout.

change_summary: Jointly reduce learning rate and dropout for the four independent NextItNet category models, preserving routing, single-checkpoint prediction, seeds and training limits.
